description: Each map is keyed by the address of the request it answers. `answers` is the agent's lane; `approvals` and `standing_approvals` are the person's, and every entry in them resolves as theirs. A close comes alone.

additionalProperties.description: An agent's answer to an input request or an agent act.

request_digest.description: The digest of the request answered, as the run reported it.

additionalProperties.title: BoundAnswer

additionalProperties.description: A person's decision, validated against the request it answers: an approval takes `approved` and `reason`, and a purchase's also the `choice` of method it pays with; a claimed call's retry takes `value: {"retry": true}`.

choice.description: The instance of the purchase request's method the person pays with.

additionalProperties.title: BoundApproval

close.description: Seal the run without continuing it: a person stopped it, or a new attempt replaced it. An effect the run left unconfirmed stays unconfirmed.
close.title: RunClose

standing_approvals.description: The person's new standing approvals, which replace the run's set for every later step and answer any open approval of a local effect they cover.

items.description: A person's bounded confirmation of the local effects a run worked by an agent would otherwise hold for them: exactly one of `edits`, `commands` and `local`. It never covers an operation's own declared approval.

commands.description: A command or process whose argv begins with these tokens.

argv_prefix.description: The exact leading argv tokens. Argv has no shell, so a prefix admits nothing beyond the tokens it names.

commands.title: StandingCommands

paths.description: Workspace-relative path prefixes, by whole components; `""` is the whole workspace.

items.title: StandingApproval
